sources.entry: FOSSBilling - Hosting and billing automation. Integrates with WHM, CWP, cPanel and HestiaCP. Full API and easily extensible. (Demo, Source Code) Apache-2.0 PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: FOSSBilling is a free, open-source billing and client management system for automating invoicing, payments, and client communication, popular with web hosting providers.
summary.what_it_does: FOSSBilling automates invoicing with reminders and basic reporting. It provides a central place for client data and communication. It supports multiple payment gateways and is described as extension-friendly for integrations and custom features. The interface is translated by the community into multiple languages and is usable on desktop and mobile. It runs on standard LAMP/LEMP stacks. The README states it is under active development and currently considered beta.
how_to_run: Follow the step-by-step Getting Started guide in the official documentation
Check the official requirements for PHP version, extensions and database
Try the public demo to explore without installing
notable: Extension-friendly architecture for integrations and custom features
Works with hosting control panels such as WHM, CWP, cPanel and HestiaCP (per awesome-selfhosted listing)
caveats: README states the project is in beta with rough edges and limited support
Requires a LAMP/LEMP web server environment with system requirements defined in external docs
